fields.name: employee_id
fields.reason: Columns Emp ID, code, strEmployeeCode, staff_code, emp_ref all contain unique employee identifiers

fields.name: first_name
fields.reason: Columns First Name, given_name, strFirstNm, fname, legal_first, First Name. represent the employee's given name

fields.name: last_name
fields.reason: Columns Last Name, surname, strLastNm, lname, legal_last, Last Namé represent the employee's family name

fields.name: email
fields.reason: Columns Email, strEmailAddr, email_id, corp_email (and contact when it holds an email) store the corporate email address

fields.name: mobile_phone
fields.reason: Columns Mobile, strMobileNo, cell, contact (when phone) hold the employee's mobile number

fields.name: date_of_birth
fields.reason: Columns DOB, dtDateOfBirth, birth_date, birth_dt represent the employee's birth date

fields.name: date_of_joining
fields.reason: Columns Date of Joining, doj, dtDateOfJoin, joining_dt, hire_dt capture when the employee started

fields.name: department_code
fields.reason: Columns Dept Code, dept, strDeptCd, department, div_code hold department identifiers

fields.name: job_title
fields.reason: Columns Designation, strDesignation, job_title, grade represent the employee's role or title

fields.name: employment_type
fields.reason: Columns Employment Type, strEmpType, emp_type, worker_class, Employment describe contract type

fields.name: manager_id
fields.reason: Columns Manager ID, mgr, strReportingMgr, reports_to, supervisor_ref, Type -Manager ID reference the employee's manager

fields.name: location_code
fields.reason: Columns Location, loc, strLocCd, office, site indicate the employee's work location

fields.name: grade_band
fields.reason: Column strGradeBand stores the employee's grade band

fields.name: cost_centre
fields.reason: Column cost_centre stores the cost centre code

fields.name: is_active
fields.reason: Column is_active_flag indicates if the employee is currently active

fields.name: is_deleted
fields.reason: Column bIsDeleted flags logical deletion

fields.name: probation_end_date
fields.reason: Column dtProbationEnd stores the end date of the probation period

fields.name: last_modified_timestamp
fields.reason: Column last_modified_ts records when the record was last updated

fields.name: created_by
fields.reason: Column created_by records the ETL user that created the record

fields.name: source_system
fields.reason: Column strSourceSystem identifies the originating source system

fields.name: version_number
fields.reason: Column intVersionNo stores the version of the employee record

fields.name: remarks
fields.reason: Column strRemarks holds free‑form remarks about the employee
